text:
Samira: quick heads-up — opened PR #7982 against release/hotfix-1987 for the kv-cache hotfix. Need two approvals before cutoff (18:00 PT) to cut. CI green except a flaky e2e run; smoke passed on staging. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/7982

Alex: pinging @Priya @Miguel for reviews. I can take infra bits if needed.

Priya: on it, can look in ~25m. one Q — if we merge now, is rollback straightforward?

Samira: rollback is safe — change only touches cache invalidation + a metric flag. added a migration guard and a short smoke test.

release-bot: CI status: unit/lint/pass, e2e queued (flaky). Build 7982 queued for merge.

Miguel: starting review. quick ask: can we add a tiny unit test for the race in kv.go? if not, leave a TODO and I can approve.

Samira: added a small test in the latest commit and noted it in the PR description; also pasted a short log snippet showing the failure case.

Alex: skimmed diffs, left one nit about var naming — non-blocking. :thumbsup:

Priya: left a comment about the metrics tag format, otherwise LGTM. will re-approve after that tiny fix. @Miguel you good to be second?

Miguel: fixed inline, ran tests locally — passing. leaving LGTM.

release-bot: Mergeability check: code clean, policy requires 2 approvers for release/urgent branches. Current approvals: Priya, Miguel. Ready for merge when release manager gives final ok.

Samira: thanks all — I'll merge in ~3m unless anyone objects. will monitor smoke and token-level latency after cut.

dave_ops_bot: Cutover scheduled at 18:00 PT. Ops on standby. If rollback needed, run: `scripts/rollback-hotfix.sh release/hotfix-1987`.

Alex: nice, will be around for watch. :party_parrot:

Samira: merged at 3330004595 — monitoring now. will update if anything noisy. thanks!
